headline: Mariam Maurice presents UVM, assertions, and coverage for ADC/DAC real-number models
fact: At DVCon U.S., Siemens EDA's Mariam Maurice presented methods for verifying ADC and DAC real-number models with randomized stimulus, functional coverage, assertions, and UVM. The paper includes constrained variation of reference and supply voltages and coverage of real-valued signal ranges. Its verification targets are modeled analog devices and their specified behavior.
